description: DEIMOS is the Deep Extragalactic Imaging Multi-Object Spectrograph on Keck II. It also images through broadband filters that sit in the converging beam between the camera and the CCD window.
facility_description: The W. M. Keck Observatory operates the two 10 m Keck telescopes on Maunakea. DEIMOS is on Keck II.
notes: Pivots, equivalent widths, glass stacks and vendors are from the Keck DEIMOS filter list. The list also has a V filter, commissioned in December 2015, whose curve is only a PDF; NJM does not include V. The page does not state a magnitude system. Faber et al. 2003, Proc. SPIE 4841, is the integration-and-testing paper. Filenames containing 'bess' or 'sdss' are not treated as a photometric-system statement, because the filter list does not use those words.
